blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The USDAU whitepaper, section D.1 clauses 3(3)-(4), prohibits transfers to blacklisted addresses and reserves issuer transfer-blocking rights. Six live deployments were verified on 2026-11-15; Tempo alone had positive observed supply. Current implementation/controller reach for those powers has not been fully resolved across the deployments, so this is Possible rather than an asserted active Yes. No absence of holder controls is inferred.
